name: QuadStack
definition: QuadStack is a novel algorithm and data structure for volumetric data compression and direct rendering of layered datasets. It exploits data redundancy in layered datasets by compressing volumetric data into vertical stacks, which are then compressed into a quadtree to identify and represent layered structures at internal nodes. It decouples associated data (color, material, density) and shape (layer heights) to achieve high compression rates.
summary: QuadStack is a data structure that compresses and directly renders layered volumetric datasets by organizing similar stacks into a quadtree to identify and compress regions with constant layer topology.
